slide_title: Radar Shooting of Positive Target (Enemy plane)

labels: FN = Actually Positive, Miss-classified as Negative
FP = Actually Negative, Miss-classified as Positive

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top. Slide number "5" in a circle at top-right. Four content blocks: small confusion matrix top-left; classification decision diagram top-right; large annotated confusion matrix bottom-left with a definition callout box beneath it; numeric confusion matrix bottom-right.

regions.name: title
regions.content: Slide title text in red, with slide number 5 in a circle at far top-right.

regions.name: small_confusion_matrix
regions.content: Small 2x2 confusion matrix titled "Predicted as" with headers P/N, row labels Actual P/N, and cells TP, FN, FP, TN with green/red fills.

regions.name: classification_diagram
regions.content: Diagram with two columns labeled "Positive" (red) and "Negative" (green), each with an airplane icon. Below are four colored circles: red 30, green 12 under Positive; green 70, red 10 under Negative. Labels "Actual" and "Predicted" on the left with a dashed horizontal divider.

regions.name: large_confusion_matrix
regions.content: Larger 2x2 confusion matrix titled "Predicted as" with colored cells (TP green, FN orange, FP yellow, TN green) and formulas to the right: "Total Positive = TP+FN", "Total Negative = FP+TN".

regions.name: definition_box
regions.position: bottom-left below matrix, roughly x: 7-47%, y: 75-85%
regions.content: Light blue box with two lines: "FN = Actually Positive, Miss-classified as Negative" and "FP = Actually Negative, Miss-classified as Positive".

regions.name: numeric_confusion_matrix
regions.content: 2x2 confusion matrix titled "Predicted as" with numeric cells: row P has 18 (green) and 12; row N has 10 and 60 (green). Formulas to the right: "Total Positive = 18+12=30", "Total Negative = 10+60=70".

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (largest, red, centered). Top-right diagram is the next most visually prominent due to size and icons. Matrices are secondary structural elements. Definition box is smallest text block.

visual_elements.description: Small confusion matrix top-left. Header row: "Predicted as" above columns P and N. Row header "Actual" vertical on left. Row P: cell P-P = TP (green fill), cell P-N = FN (red/orange fill). Row N: cell N-P = FP (red/orange fill), cell N-N = TN (green fill).

Classification diagram top-right. Two column headers: "Positive" in red text, "Negative" in green text. Under each is a line-drawing airplane icon. A horizontal dashed line runs across the middle. Below the line: left cluster has red circle "30" and green circle "12"; right cluster has green circle "70" and red circle "10". Arrows connect the airplane icons to the circles below. Blue text labels "Actual" and "Predicted" appear on the left side of this panel.

Large confusion matrix bottom-left. Header "Predicted as" above columns P and N. Row header "Actual" vertical on left. Row P: cell P-P = TP (bright green fill), cell P-N = FN (light orange fill). Row N: cell N-P = FP (light yellow fill), cell N-N = TN (bright green fill). To the right of the matrix: "Total Positive = TP+FN" and "Total Negative = FP+TN".
Light blue rectangular callout box below the large matrix containing two lines of black text defining FN and FP.

Numeric confusion matrix bottom-right. Header "Predicted as" above columns P and N. Row header "Actual" vertical on left. Row P: cell P-P = 18 (bright green fill), cell P-N = 12. Row N: cell N-P = 10, cell N-N = 60 (bright green fill). To the right: "Total Positive = 18+12=30" and "Total Negative = 10+60=70".

imagery.description: Two line-drawing airplane icons in the top-right diagram. Left airplane under "Positive" appears to be a military/enemy plane with a star insignia. Right airplane under "Negative" appears to be a civilian passenger plane with windows. Both are simple black outline illustrations.
imagery.position: top-right panel, under the Positive and Negative column headers

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large, bold, dark red, with the word "Positive" underlined. Matrix headers and labels are bold black. Cell text is black. Definition box text is black on light blue. Slide number "5" is black inside a white circle with a purple/pink outline.
